summary.text: Billy Garrett is a Republican who represents Senate District 10 (Greenwood, Lexington and Saluda Counties) in the South Carolina Senate and serves on the Banking and Insurance, Finance, Fish, Game and Forestry, Labor, Commerce and Industry, and Medical Affairs committees.

paragraphs.text: Garrett is an attorney with The Garrett Law Firm, P.C., and a circuit court and family court mediator.
He graduated from Lander University with a B.A. in 1978 and from the University of South Carolina School of Law with a J.D. in 1983.
His page lists him as a founding member of the S.C. Criminal Defense Attorneys and as the recipient of the 2022 Public Service Award of the S.C. Baptist Convention.
